SAC_reduction: one-step optimal finite actor softmax(minQ/alpha); deterministic argmax equals same-Q greedy for positive alpha; not full multi-step robot SAC exploration

FRESH16.incomplete_action_coverage: Exact actual counts from approved build; NOT_FULLY_EXPLORED, never use future mask

dataset_identity_status: NOT_BUILT; first complete two-job root binding, separately approved read-only builder, freeze actual bytes before fit approval
pending_approval_requirements: root exact closed two-job binding including CURRENT/COMPUTATION SHA
actual dataset and manifest bytes SHA
final immutable contract new SHA and main explicit one-shot real-fit approval
external finite timeout/resource stream; failure no automatic retry
required_accounting: linear head forward/softmax/apply counters before execution
successful steps/risk cost gradient examples/alpha iterations
retain all original physical costs; synthetic separated
strong_controls: single IF stump: action observed in all training leaf cases

target.JF_JM: Independent physical full-task heads; risk separate; no current-result action mask
target.return: complete original qualified clip((JF_B-JF)/max(JF_B,1),-.9,.9), else -1 only original complete motion failure; gain1 shared
target.strict_JM: Actual JM and motion always separate; original-qualified does not mean JM-nonincreasing
target.terminal_Q: y=canonical return; done=True, no bootstrap/next-state entropy

training.CV: leave entire case SHA, duplicate case/action never crosses fold
training.Q: same twin initialization seed for all mechanisms; minQ terminal
training.actor: same exact frozen BC3->5 common logit lift; phase logits mean of H150 rows
training.missing: UNKNOWN_MISSING_ACTION_LABEL; no imputation or future-qualification mask
training.normalization: inherited frozen common BC parent, no refit; parent historical exposure makes case CV diagnostic only
training.risk: original failure logistic report only, no future mask
training.support: RMS<=1 and >=2 distinct training case groups per action; repeated rollouts do not raise count
training.weights: actual empirical rows; repeated real samples are not independent contexts
